title: Your First Weekend at United States Naval Academy, Shared as Cards
description: A conservative, under-21-safe first-weekend sequence combining Academy orientation with nearby public Annapolis landmarks. Confirm campus access and any event-specific restrictions before going.

cards.title: Start at the Visitor Center
cards.subtitle: Gate 1, United States Naval Academy
cards.notes: Use the Visitor Center as the practical starting point: pick up current visitor information and ask which Academy areas are accessible that day.
cards.short_summary: Begin with current on-site orientation and access information.
cards.evidence_claim: USNA Admissions identifies the Visitor Center at 52 King George Street and directs visitors there for Academy visits.
cards.access_notes: General public visitation resumed May 11, 2026, but Academy access is controlled; verify entry requirements before arrival.

cards.title: Attend an Admissions Briefing
cards.subtitle: Visitor Center, United States Naval Academy
cards.notes: If you are considering USNA, use the daily briefing to ground the weekend in official information before exploring the Yard and Annapolis.
cards.short_summary: Hear admissions information directly from USNA.
cards.evidence_claim: USNA states that daily in-person admissions briefings are available at 1000 and 1400.
cards.access_notes: USNA lists daily briefings at 1000 and 1400; confirm status before traveling.

cards.title: Take a Guided Yard Tour
cards.subtitle: Departing from the Visitor Center
cards.notes: Choose a scheduled guided tour if offered, then use it to learn the layout and history without assuming unrestricted access to campus spaces.
cards.short_summary: See the Yard through the official visitor-tour program.
cards.evidence_claim: USNA directs visitors to the Naval Academy Tourism website for available tours and ticket purchases.
cards.access_notes: Tour availability and access conditions can change; purchase or reserve only through the official tour provider.

cards.title: Browse Preble Hall Exhibits
cards.subtitle: Preble Hall, United States Naval Academy
cards.notes: Spend time with the ship models, artifacts, and seapower exhibits; the museum provides a focused introduction to Navy and Academy history.
cards.short_summary: Two floors of naval-history exhibits in Preble Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Naval Academy Museum is in Preble Hall and presents exhibits on seapower, the U.S. Navy, and the Academy.
cards.access_notes: Museum access depends on Academy entry conditions; its official page directs visitors to plan their visit.

cards.title: See the Academy Chapel
cards.subtitle: United States Naval Academy
cards.notes: When it is open for visitors, take a quiet look at the chapel’s architecture and remember that services and official events take priority.
cards.short_summary: A prominent Academy chapel with active religious use.
cards.evidence_claim: USNA’s chaplaincy describes the Brigade of Midshipmen Chapel as part of its chapel heritage and virtual-tour offerings.
cards.source_title: Virtual Chapel Tours | Chaplains Center | USNA
cards.access_notes: Visitor access may be limited by worship services, ceremonies, and Academy security; confirm on arrival.

cards.title: Visit the John Paul Jones Crypt
cards.subtitle: Brigade of Midshipmen Chapel, United States Naval Academy
cards.notes: Pair the crypt with the chapel stop and use the Academy’s interpretive material to understand its connection to naval history.
cards.short_summary: A named historic crypt within the Academy chapel complex.
cards.evidence_claim: USNA includes the Crypt of John Paul Jones among the chapel spaces presented in its virtual chapel tours.
cards.source_title: Virtual Chapel Tours | Chaplains Center | USNA
cards.access_notes: Access follows chapel and Academy visitor conditions; do not enter during services or private events.

cards.title: Step Inside the Maryland State House
cards.subtitle: 100 State Circle, Annapolis
cards.notes: Use the self-guided information on the first floor, allowing time for the required security screening and photo-ID check at entry.
cards.short_summary: A public historic building with self-guided material.
cards.evidence_claim: The Maryland State Archives says the State House is open to the public daily from 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., except Christmas and New Year’s Day.
cards.access_notes: Photo ID and metal-detector screening are required; public hours are 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. daily except Christmas and New Year’s Day.

cards.title: Read the City Dock Memorial
cards.subtitle: City Dock, historic Annapolis
cards.notes: Walk the sculpture group, Compass Rose, and Story Wall slowly; use the plaques as prompts for a thoughtful conversation about family history.
cards.short_summary: A three-part City Dock memorial centered on history and remembrance.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Annapolis describes the memorial as three areas: the Alex Haley sculpture group, Compass Rose, and Story Wall.
cards.access_notes: Located at City Dock; respect the memorial and any temporary event setup in the area.

cards.title: Pause at Susan Campbell Park
cards.subtitle: City Dock, Spa Creek, Annapolis
cards.notes: Make this a short waterfront reset: sit, look across Spa Creek, and note any civic programming without relying on an event being scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A waterfront civic space at City Dock.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Annapolis identifies Susan Campbell Park as its most visible waterfront park and civic space on Spa Creek.
cards.source_title: City of Annapolis Water Access Plan
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public space; conditions may be affected by weather, tides, or permitted events.

cards.title: Finish with the Park Campus Trails
cards.subtitle: 7300 Edgewood Road, Annapolis
cards.notes: Use the waterfront trails and public paddle-craft launch for a daylight outdoor finish; bring what you need and follow posted waterfront guidance.
cards.short_summary: A 12-acre waterfront park with trails and a public launch.
cards.evidence_claim: The Annapolis Maritime Museum & Park says its Park Campus is open daily dawn to dusk and includes hiking trails and a public paddle-craft launch.
cards.source_title: Visit 2025 | The Annapolis Maritime Museum & Park
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk according to the museum; use the trails and launch only in daylight and follow posted site guidance.

warnings: Campus access, tours, and chapel availability are subject to security procedures and official events; verify details immediately before visiting.
